parent.name: Dresses
parent.detailLine: A neckline. A hem. A different feeling.
parent.campaignNote: The collection header images and the original Dresses and Club Dresses films are illustrative styling inspiration.

collections.name: Boho Dresses
collections.headline:
A little freedom.
A lot of you.
collections.description: Expressive prints, easy shapes and room to move. Discover a boho dress for unhurried days and spontaneous plans.
collections.advice: Try a printed dress with simple sandals and a soft bag. Keep jewellery understated, or pick out a single colour from the pattern for your accessories.

collections.name: Casual Dresses
collections.headline:
No big occasion.
Just a good day.
collections.description: Easy silhouettes and everyday possibility. Find a casual dress that feels right from the first coffee to the last plan.
collections.advice: Start with flats and a denim jacket, then switch to a different shoe when the evening arrives. Choose a length and neckline that work with the layers you already love.

collections.name: Club Dresses
collections.headline:
Lights on.
Eyes on you.
collections.description: The original night-out edit, with its animated campaign header.
collections.advice: Choose a silhouette that feels comfortable when you move, and let one detail lead the outfit.

collections.name: Cocktail & Evening Dresses
collections.headline:
The evening
starts with you.
collections.description: Considered necklines, a little drama and a reason to dress up. Explore cocktail and evening styles for the plans worth making.
collections.advice: An expressive neckline or sleeve needs little competition. Keep the accessories simple, check the dress code and choose shoes that suit the evening ahead.

collections.name: Long Dresses
collections.headline:
A longer line.
A lasting impression.
collections.description: Fluid-looking shapes, striking prints and elegant lengths. Discover a long dress with your kind of presence.
collections.advice: Try the dress with the shoes you plan to wear and check the stated length. A defined waist can balance a flowing skirt; a simpler neckline lets the silhouette lead.

collections.name: Short Dresses
collections.headline:
A shorter hem.
A fresh feeling.
collections.description: Playful shapes and thoughtful details. Find a short dress for everyday moments, evening plans and everything between.
collections.advice: Try a shorter dress with a relaxed jacket or a more covered neckline. Check the garment length and fit measurements to choose the coverage that feels right for you.

collections.name: Spring Dresses
collections.headline:
Fresh plans.
A lighter mood.
collections.description: New-season colours, expressive patterns and easy movement. Discover a dress for those first brighter days.
collections.advice: A light cardigan or cropped jacket makes a spring dress easier to wear through a changing day. Choose a layer that sits comfortably over the sleeves and neckline.

collections.name: Summer Dresses
collections.headline:
Follow the
sunshine.
collections.description: Relaxed silhouettes, open necklines and a warm-weather outlook. Find a summer dress for days with no fixed agenda.
collections.advice: Choose a fit that feels comfortable in warm weather and check fabric composition and opacity. Finish with simple sandals and a light layer for later.

collections.name: Tea Length Dresses
collections.headline:
Somewhere between.
Entirely your own.
collections.description: A considered hemline and plenty of personality. Explore tea-length styles, from printed day dresses to occasion-ready shapes.
collections.advice: Tea-length hems sit differently depending on height. Compare the listed length with a dress you own, and try it with the shoes you plan to wear.

collections.name: Two Piece Dresses
collections.headline:
Together today.
Your way tomorrow.
collections.description: Coordinated shapes with room to make them personal. Explore two-piece dress sets and find a pairing you love.
collections.advice: Check the measurements for both pieces and how much space sits between them. Wear the set together, or style one piece with a simple wardrobe favourite.

collections.name: Winter Dresses
collections.headline:
A little texture.
A different season.
collections.description: Longer sleeves, knit-inspired shapes and winter-ready styling possibilities. Find a dress to build your cooler-day outfit around.
collections.advice: Try a fitted dress beneath a relaxed coat, or add a neat cardigan over a fuller skirt. Check fibre composition and garment weight before choosing for colder conditions.

collections.name: Floral Dresses
collections.headline:
In full
expression.
collections.description: From a delicate motif to a bolder bloom. Discover floral dresses that bring colour and movement to your plans.
collections.advice: Choose one shade from the print for a bag or shoe, and keep the rest of the outfit quiet. A simple jacket can make the same dress feel more everyday.

collections.name: Maxi Dresses
collections.headline:
Go long.
Feel effortless.
collections.description: Sweeping shapes and a little movement with every step. Find a maxi dress for slow days and standout evenings.
collections.advice: Check the full garment length against your height and chosen shoes. Keep the upper layers simple so the long silhouette has room to do its work.

collections.name: Sequin Dresses
collections.headline:
Catch the light.
Keep the moment.
collections.description: A little shimmer changes the whole feeling. Explore the sequin edit for evenings that call for something extra.
collections.advice: Pair a sequin dress with understated shoes and a small bag. Check the lining and care instructions on the product listing, especially around delicate embellishment.

collections.name: Wedding Guest Dresses
collections.headline:
For their day.
Your kind of style.
collections.description: A considered silhouette for a special invitation. Explore the wedding guest edit and make the finishing touches your own.
collections.advice: Check the couple’s dress code, venue and season before choosing. Consider a light layer for the ceremony and shoes that work for the setting.

collections.name: Work Dresses
collections.headline:
A considered
start.
collections.description: Clean-looking lines and thoughtful details from the work dress edit. A starting point for a wardrobe that works your way.
collections.advice: Check the length and fit against your workplace dress expectations. A simple jacket and understated shoes help the same dress adapt to different plans.
